title: agent_registry.yml
description: Lists the AI agents (tools, models, machines) the L4 identity gate will accept in commit trailers. Adding a new agent vendor is a one-line addition here. See docs/concepts/four-quadrants.md § 'L4 burn-in'.

tools.description: Permitted values for the Agent-Tool trailer. Vendor-neutral; add 'manual' for human-authored commits and 'github-actions' for CI-authored commits.

models.description: Map from Agent-Tool value to list of accepted Agent-Model values. Use ['*'] to accept any model for a tool.

machines.description: Free-form list of recognized Agent-Machine values. Machines NOT in this list still pass the trailer check (they go into L4 burn-in instead of hard-blocking).
